name: Imperial Pike Guards
headerMeta: Heroic era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 240 leadership · Honour Unit
pitch: A high-DPS pike line that runs over cavalry and anything charging it, trading survivability for lethality on advance-based play. It falls apart against crowd control that baits the advance or chains it down — disengage early or lose the unit.

doctrines.name: Epic Polearm Doctrine (Pike Charge)
doctrines.effect: Pike Charge doctrine: unlocks a charge order that can one-shot diving heroes; allows a 180 degree turn to re-brace if flanked.

doctrines.name: Rare Polearm Doctrine
doctrines.effect: +100 dmg while bracing, affects Advance. Top pick.
doctrines.note: +100 dmg while bracing, flat amount that also affects Advance

doctrines.ref: Epic Polearm Doctrine (+80 piercing dmg, +120 piercing AP)
doctrines.name: Epic Polearm Doctrine (+80 piercing dmg, +120 piercing AP)
Epic Bloodthirsty Doctrine
doctrines.effect: 12% lifesteal for 6s after dealing damage, +12% DMG when HP above 60%.
doctrines.note: lifesteal + 12% dmg; swap in for Brace DMG or Advance CD if you need more sustain

veterancy.label: Full Top
veterancy.body: Damage line — extreme damage output, final perk lets the pike strike two enemy units on one hit; stun-immune while advancing. Best for annihilation play, but not recommended for XP tactics on this unit since survivability drops badly on a second engagement.

veterancy.label: Full Bot
veterancy.body: Defense line — flat +20% defense at the final node, stun-immune while braced; built for base/defensive tactics and absorbing head-on charges rather than XP tactics.

battleRole.positioning: Charge in or X-move in to close to melee range — the unit does more damage the faster the enemy is closing, so bait charges rather than lead passively. {1} Line pikes facing outward against a wall and brace to catch cavalry charging from behind. {3}
battleRole.formation: Dispersed: wide spread, cuts incoming ranged fire, good for walking into a large group. Line: wide-front blocking or clearing, including bracing against a wall. Skirmish/Circle: tightest formation, best for locking down a small area and concentrating fire on one target. {3}
battleRole.tips: First tick of Advance can be 'bugged' and hit for insane damage. {1} Brace (Stand Firm) works in or out of formation; Advance runs over heroes and most units, and cavalry stand almost no chance against it. {3} Don't hesitate to disengage from your initial CC/advance if you can save the unit. {1}

matchups.pressure: You pressure: cavalry, units with block, and anything closing at high speed — Advance and its anti-cav trait mean charging cav into a braced or advancing line is a near-guaranteed loss for the cavalry. {1}{3}

controls.notes: Charge in or X-move in. {1} Advance when near melee range; wait for hits to stack. {1} Press 3 after the stack; kill count reduces Advance CD (sometimes to zero), allowing immediate re-advance. {1} Brace Damage (Rare Polearm) is a flat amount affecting Advance — top-pick status. {1} Brace (Stand Firm) works in any formation or out of formation; stun-immunity is formation-dependent — top line while advancing, bottom line while braced. {3}
